format: Traditional Qdoba restaurant (1,500 to 3,000 sq ft, mostly in-line or end cap), excluding real property and liquor license costs

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Qdoba restaurant is $548,100 to $1,294,000. This includes $40,000 which must be paid to us or our affiliates.

fee.quote: The Franchise Fee for traditional units is $40,000 and the Franchise Fee for Non-Traditional units is $20,000, plus any tax or other fees imposed on the Company due to the collection of the Franchise Fee.
fee.note: VetFran: Initial Franchise Fee reduced by $10,000 for honorably discharged U.S. military. Terms shorter than 10 years: $4,000 per year. Development Fee $10,000 per restaurant, may be credited toward the Franchise Fee. Franchise Fees actually paid last fiscal year: $0 to $40,000 (negotiated).

royalty.quote: Royalty Five percent (5%) of gross sales Payable weekly ... Royalties at non-traditional sites are six percent (6%); lower rates have been set in unusual situations.

adFund.quote: Marketing Fee Currently four and one half percent (4.50%) of gross sales for franchisees and one and three-quarters percent (1.75%) of gross sales for licensees. ... Company may propose to increase the fee up to six percent (6%), but increases or decreases require approval by majority vote.
adFund.note: Currently 4.5% (up to 6% with majority vote). Local advertising: currently no requirement. Item 19 says combined advertising was 4.0% in fiscal 2025, raised to 4.5% on September 29, 2025. Grand opening advertising $10,000 to $25,000 required.

otherRecurring.name: IT Support Services
otherRecurring.amount: Currently $250 per restaurant per period plus 0.21% of weekly gross sales (13 periods per year)

otherRecurring.name: Lease Administration Fee
otherRecurring.amount: $100 Payable monthly (only if Franchisee subleases the location from Company)

otherRecurring.name: Catering Rewards Program / Catering Call Center Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Varies (pro rata share of program and call center costs)

transferFee.amount: Up to $5,000 Prior to consummation of transfer
